title: New project
created: Done: questionnaire, assignation and project created

questions.subtitle: Paste every question you need and the AI builds the questionnaire, or use one you already have.
questions.chatTitle: Paste your questions or describe the questionnaire
questions.chatHint: Numbered, bulleted or however you have them. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line break.
questions.chatChangesHint: Ask the assistant here: each new version replaces the previous one.
questions.chatDoneHint: It is saved. Go on to the next step.
questions.greeting: Hi! Paste the questions you need here, or tell me what the questionnaire is about. For example: "Here are 30 questions, make a questionnaire".
questions.approved: Done, your questionnaire **{{title}}** has been created. You can go on to the next step or [edit it here]({{url}}).
questions.approvedNotSaved: **{{title}}** is approved. It will be saved when you press Create.
questions.chatNotInPlan: The assistant isn't included in your plan. Use an existing questionnaire instead.
questions.existingTitle: Choose a questionnaire you already have
questions.existingHint: Of any type. It is used as it is: nothing is copied or changed.

organization.subtitle: Choose the organization and who will respond to this follow-up.
organization.question: Which organization will this questionnaire be assigned to?
organization.create: Not listed? Create a new one
organization.createHint: Name, domain and its members. You come back here with it chosen.
organization.assignationNameHint: Built from the organization and the questionnaire. You can change it.
organization.copyWarning: This questionnaire is already assigned to "{{organization}}". A copy of the questionnaire will be created and the copy will be assigned instead.
organization.notInPlan: Creating organizations isn't included in your plan. Choose an existing one.

audience.label: Who responds?
audience.hint: The whole organization, or only some people, areas or roles.
audience.search: Search by name, email, area or role
audience.missingArea: No member of this organization has an area yet. Add it to the members in Organizations to target by area.
audience.missingRole: No member of this organization has a role yet. Add it to the members in Organizations to target by role.

project.hero: Group the follow-up in a project
project.subtitle: So you see in one place what has been answered and what you need to review.
project.question: Which project will this follow-up go into?
project.hint: A project groups the follow-up assignations of one organization and shows which question each one is on.
project.create: Not listed? Create a new one
project.createHint: The organization and this assignation come already set.
project.noOrganizationHint: Projects belong to an organization. Choose it in step 2 and come back here.

summary.title: What we're going to create
summary.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you press Create at the end. The assignation is a Follow-up: its members share one session and get a daily reminder until it is completed.

errors.approveDraft: Approve the draft in the chat to continue.
errors.assignedElsewhere: Another organization started following this questionnaire. Press Create again to assign a copy.

organizationDialog.title: New organization
organizationDialog.description: Set up the organization and add its members. It is created together with the project.
organizationDialog.name: Name
organizationDialog.membersHint: Each member needs a name and at least an email or a phone. The email domain is only a hint.
organizationDialog.domainWarning: {{count}} member(s) use a domain other than {{domain}}. They will be saved anyway.

projectDialog.title: New project
projectDialog.description: A project groups the follow-up assignations of one organization and shows which question each one is on.
projectDialog.name: Project name
projectDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What this project is about. Only your team sees it.

errors.deadlineRequired: Choose a deadline for the project
